title: Juicy Fresh Greek Zucchini Salad
description: A fresh, tender Greek dish featuring lemon juice and other simple ingredients for a cozy and diabetic-friendly meal.

ingredients.name: zucchini
ingredients.notes: preferably firm, about 8-10 inches in length

ingredients.name: kalamata olives
ingredients.notes: for extra flavor and a pop of color

ingredients.name: lemon juice
ingredients.notes: freshly squeezed for optimal flavor and texture

ingredients.name: red pepper flakes
ingredients.notes: for a touch of heat, optional

instructions: Slice zucchini into half-moons about 1/8 inch thick.
In a large bowl, combine sliced zucchinis with halved kalamata olives and finely chopped red onion.
Drizzle olive oil over the mixture and toss gently to coat.
Add finely chopped basil leaves and freshly squeezed lemon juice. Toss again until all ingredients are evenly coated.
Season lightly with salt if needed, then sprinkle red pepper flakes on top (if using).
Gently fold in mixed greens for additional freshness and nutrients.
